Yes, the rental amount will be AED 6,000for 30 nights booking, along with a AED 2,000 refundable security deposit, as previously mentioned.

Please note that if you choose to make the payment through the payment link, a 3.1% card processing fee will be applied.

Alternatively, if you prefer to proceed with a bank transfer, no additional charges will be applicable.

Thank you.
